niche: Mind Hacks, AI Secrets, Bizarre Body Science & Hidden Power Dynamics

ideas.title: The Blue Vegetable Brain Blindness
ideas.angle: An interactive rapid-fire test where I force the viewer to think of a vegetable after a specific sequence, then reveal they thought of 'Carrot'. It forces engagement through a 'how did you know' comment trigger.

hook.en: Quick, name a vegetable right now!

ideas.reason: Interactive mind-reading tests (like the Red Hammer glitch) are currently the highest-performing content in the Dark Psychology pillar, achieving over 110% APV because users rewatch to see where their brain 'tripped'.

ideas.title: The 1-Second Respect Signal
ideas.angle: Explains the 'Eyebrow Flash' and the 'Power Gaze' (looking at the forehead instead of eyes). It gives a physical command the viewer can try immediately in the mirror or on camera.

hook.en: Stop looking people in the eyes.

ideas.reason: Social power dynamics and 'unspoken rules' are trending on TikTok and YouTube Shorts. This specific micro-behavior (forehead gazing) is a viral 'dark' tip used to dominate social interactions.
sources: Joe Navarro - What Every Body is Saying

ideas.title: The T-Rex Nerve Glitch
ideas.angle: A physical 'body hack' where the viewer holds their hands in a specific 'claw' position while trying to move their ring finger. It creates a physical sensation of paralysis that forces a comment to confirm it worked.

hook.en: Your brain can't move this finger.

ideas.reason: Physical 'glitch' videos have a 90%+ VVSA rate because they offer an immediate, undeniable sensory experience that makes the viewer feel like their body is 'broken'.
